newsitem.title: USA: Enova to manage power for Calif. shipyard.
newsitem.headline: Enova to manage power for Calif. shipyard.

text.p: Enova Energy, the energy services subsidiary of Enova Corp and parent company of San Diego Gas & Electric Co, announced Wednesday an agreement with the city of Pittsburg, Calif., to manage the city's gas and electric facilities at nearby Mare Island.
Mare Island, about 25 miles northeast of San Francisco, is the former U.S. Naval Shipyard in northern California.

As part of a long-term contract, Enova Energy will operate and maintain the Navy power facilities that were bought by Pittsburg as well as operate and manage power distribution, buy natural gas and electricity on Pittsburg's behalf, and assist with billing services.
The power demand is estimated at four megawatts of electricity.
Pittsburg, an industrial city of about 50,000 residents, lies along the Sacramento River in Contra Costa County.
